files.patch: @@ -935,2 +935,6 @@ - In summary, tags for value objects use value equality semantics, and - the event is not sent for tagged value objects. + Object tags are jlong values + that a agent can associate with an object. + Value objects can be tagged by but the tag is associated with the object's + field values, as it has no identity. + The event is not sent for tagged value objects. +
